node.textContent: A demo shop for Hindcast — nothing here is for sale.
Free delivery on orders over $300 · Made in small runs · 30-year joinery guarantee
Solid wood, honest joinery and nothing that needs replacing in three years. Made in small runs, shipped flat, built to be kept.

attributes.alt: A calm living room with a linen sofa and an olive tree

node.textContent: We make fewer things, and make them
Every surface you touch is the same timber all the way through — so a scratch sands out instead of showing chipboard.
Small batches from two workshops we visit every season. When a run sells out, the next one takes about six weeks.
Dovetails, mortise and tenon, no glue-and-staple shortcuts. Everything carries a thirty-year guarantee on the frame.
Solid-wood furniture and considered objects, made in small runs and built to be kept.
New pieces and studio notes, twice a month.
Sized for a hallway or a bedroom corner — room for a laptop, a lamp and not much else, on purpose. Solid black walnut on tapered legs, finished in hard-wax oil.
